stoppingRule: Run all six shared startup cases: 1000, 10000 and 100000 tasks with a restarted sync service and a warm second client. Require distinct fresh processes and initially empty SDK memory caches, exact first-screen and full-dataset validation, parent monotonic milestones, scoped process samples and route counters. Preserve failures. This smoke validates the memory profile and does not establish a performance comparison or process durability.
